p054 l.3 at 1500 dpi: مغفرة has a clear fatha over the fa and no kasra under it (A is right). رضوانا has one single fatha stroke over the nun, not the double tanween stroke seen on وعافيةً/ومغفرةً beside it (B is right). Both are print slips, kept as printed.
p056 l.11 at 1800 dpi: الإجابة has only the hamza under the alif and no kasra stroke, unlike إِنِّي on the same page. A is right, as printed.

extra_edits.note: p056 l.9 at 2400 dpi: the waw of عدوا has only the two parallel tanween strokes and no shadda (compare ضالِّين/مضلِّين on the same line, where the shadda is clear). Both keyers added a shadda that is not printed.

keyA.notes: No footnotes, headings or Quran on pp.053-056 (all fully vowelled dua prose of حزب الفتح الصديقي). p.052 ends with a complete sentence and p.053 opens with an indented line, so p.053 has no '+'; pp.054 and 056 continue the previous page's sentence ('+'); p.055 starts a new indented paragraph. Small alif over final ى (إِلَى، عَلَى، النَّوَى) is the automatic Lotus glyph and is written as plain ى. The print often puts sukun on a long ya/waw (وَإِسْرَافِيْلَ، فِيْمَا، خَطِيْئَتِي، دُوْنَكَ); kept as printed. Marks deliberately absent as printed: الوَهَّاب. ; شيءٍ (p.053, no fatha on shin); شَقيًّا (no kasra on qaf); وَأَسْأَلُك لِسَانًا (no fatha on kaf, p.054); تَعْلَم، ×2; وَأَعْظِم (no sukun); اجْعَل لِّي. p.054 أَصْلِح لِي: a single kasra sits inside the bowl of the final ha and no sukun is printed; read as the lam's kasra (أَصْلِحْ imperative) — reviewer may wish to confirm. p.056 سَلَمًا printed with fatha on sin and lam. Zooms were rendered from zoom.py coordinates (the pages\ PNGs are framed differently from the PDF page box).

keyB.notes: p053 starts a new indented paragraph after p052 ended with «يَا رَحْمَنُ.», so there is no + marker; p052's footnotes end on that page, so there is no (تابع). p054 and p056 continue sentences from the previous page (+). There are no footnotes, headings or bold on pp.053-056: the whole dua is set in one heavier font. p053: the kasra under «الله» in «بِسْمِ اللهِ» sits low between the lines but belongs to line 1, and «بِاللهِ» also has a printed kasra. Following my earlier batches, Allah is written with only the printed case vowel (the automatic ligature shadda/small alif is not written). p053: the print has no space after the comma in «يَخْتَلِفُون،اهْدِنِي»; I wrote one space under the one-space-between-words rule. Final ى in إِلَى/عَلَى/وَالنَّوَى/وَتَرْضَى has the automatic Lotus small alif, so it is written as plain ى. Partial vowelling is kept as printed, for example: نَعَّار، (no vowel on the ra'), الوَهَّاب., يَخْتَلِفُون، (no fatha on the nun), شيءٍ (p053, no fatha on the shin) against شَيء، and شَيءٌ (p054), عَيْن، (p054), أَصْلِح (kasra only on the lam), تَعْلَم، (twice), وَعَلَيكَ (first occurrence on p056, no sukun on the ya'), بَيْن يَدَيَّ, اجْعَل لِّي, وَأَعْظِم. Sukun printed on a madd ya' or waw is kept: وَإِسْرَافِيْلَ, فِيْمَا, خَطِيْئَتِي, دُوْنَكَ. Shadda is written before its vowel throughout.
